name: Korea Investment Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, Korea Investment Holdings Co., Ltd., founded in 2003, is a financial conglomerate that delivers a wide array of financial products and services through its various subsidiaries. Its offerings encompass securities trading, asset management, savings bank operations, brokerage, credit financing, venture capital investments, private equity fund (PEF) management, and general trading. Additionally, the company is active in real estate trust businesses and provides specialized investment banking and hedge fund management services. The firm was formerly known as Dongwon Financial Holding Co., Ltd. before officially adopting its current name in May 2005.
